Implement the following requested change in the repository.

Add missing NumPy ufuncs: `abs`, `left_shift`, `right_shift`, `positive`
Add these to `dask.array` for consistency with both `numpy` and the Array API (https://github.com/dask/community/issues/109).

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: dask/array/__init__.py, dask/array/ufunc.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
